## Synchronization

Types are auto-generated by Supabase when migrations run.

**To update types after schema change:**
1. Run migration via Lovable
2. Types auto-update in `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts`
3. Update aliases in `src/types/supabase-aliases.ts` if needed
